purpose.zh-Hant: 由文字限制建立可行區域，再選擇連續或整數最優解。
purpose.en: Build a feasible region from constraints, then distinguish continuous and integer optimisation.

prerequisites.zh-Hant: 二元一次方程、不等式、坐標與整數限制。
prerequisites.en: Simultaneous linear equations, inequalities, coordinates and integer constraints.

scopeNote.zh-Hant: 本頁提供基本方法導讀及現有題庫入口；進階分支與完整圖解會繼續補充，並非完整課綱或全章筆記。
scopeNote.en: This is a foundational method guide and an entry to the published bank. Advanced branches and complete visual explanations are still being developed; this is not a complete syllabus or chapter note.

title.en: Translate constraints into a feasible region

intro.zh-Hant: 先畫邊界直線，再用不在邊界上的測試點決定半平面。所有限制的交集才是可行區域。
intro.en: Draw each boundary, then use a test point off the line to choose a half-plane. The feasible region is the intersection of all constraints.

trigger.zh-Hant: 先處理 x、y 的非負或整數限制，再列資源、時間及數量條件；嚴格不等號邊界不包含在內。
trigger.en: Record nonnegative and integer restrictions, then resource, time and quantity constraints. Strict inequalities exclude their boundaries.

trap.zh-Hant: 測試點不可在邊界上；圖窗只是顯示範圍，不是額外限制。
trap.en: A test point must not lie on the boundary. The plotting window is not an extra constraint.

intro.zh-Hant: 在非空、有界、包含邊界的多邊形可行區域，線性目標式至少在一個頂點取得最大及最小值。先解邊界交點，再逐個檢查可行性。
intro.en: For a nonempty bounded polygonal feasible region including its boundary, a linear objective attains maxima and minima at vertices. Solve boundary intersections and check each for feasibility.

trigger.zh-Hant: 列頂點表，代入同一目標式比較；有整條邊同值時，最優解可能不唯一。
trigger.en: Make a vertex table and evaluate the same objective at each point. An entire edge can share an optimum, so the solution may not be unique.

trap.zh-Hant: 開邊界可能只有上確界或下確界而沒有取到的最值；無界區域要另查目標是否無界。
trap.en: Open boundaries may give a supremum or infimum without an attained optimum. For an unbounded region, check whether the objective is unbounded.

title.zh-Hant: 整數解：唔好把連續解直接四捨五入
title.en: Integer solutions: do not simply round

intro.zh-Hant: 數量題可能要求整數。連續最優頂點若不是整數，四捨五入未必可行，更未必最優。
intro.en: Counts may require integers. Rounding a continuous optimum can produce an infeasible or non-optimal point.

trigger.zh-Hant: 在可行範圍按固定 x 或 y 列出整數點，再比較目標值；嚴格邊界要先排除。
trigger.en: Enumerate feasible integer points by fixing x or y, then compare objective values. Exclude strict boundaries first.

trap.zh-Hant: 只有確認所有可行候選已涵蓋，才能宣稱最優；不可憑最接近圖上頂點決定。
trap.en: An optimum needs coverage of all feasible candidates, not just points visually close to a continuous vertex.
